Trent Alexander-Arnold will be expected to start, while Xabi Alonso won’t be able to deploy Aurelien Tchouameni or Eder Militao.Real Madrid predicted XI: Courtois, Alexander-Arnold, Asencio, Huijsen, Carreras, Camavinga, Güler, Bellingham, Valverde, Vinicius, Mbappé.Elche predicted XI: Dituro; Núñez, Affengruber, Bigas, Pedrosa; Valera, Febas, Aguado, Mendoza; Rafa Mir, André Silva.Valverde will likely play on Real Madrid’s right wing for the first time this season, and it will be interesting to see if the team improves its cohesion and offensive game.HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGADate: 11/23/2025Time: 21:00 CET, 03:00pm EST.Venue: Martinez Valero, Elche, Spain.Available TV: DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).Available Streaming: ESPN+ (USA)Managing Madrid has affiliate partnerships.
